Bootstrap.rationale: Bootstrap versions below 4.x are treated as legacy and should be reviewed.

WordPress.rationale: WordPress versions below 6.x should be checked against current vendor maintenance status.

jQuery.rationale: jQuery versions below 3.x are treated as legacy and should be reviewed.

notes: Minimum versions are operator-maintained policy baselines, not live vulnerability intelligence.
Update this file when the organisation changes its accepted support baseline.
